proof:
pull-first : f ∘ g ≈ a → f ∘ ((g ∘ h) ∘ i) ≈ a ∘ (h ∘ i)
pull-first {f = f} {g = g} {a = a} {h = h} {i = i} eq = begin
  f ∘ (g ∘ h) ∘ i ≈⟨ refl⟩∘⟨ assoc ⟩
  f ∘ g ∘ h ∘ i   ≈⟨ pullˡ eq ⟩
  a ∘ h ∘ i       ∎
